I've read the diff (package.json + lock only), verified against the codebase, and checked for callers of the removed/added packages.

Analysis:
- The diff only touches `package.json` and `package-lock.json` — no source code changes, no new sinks introduced by the diff itself.
- The `@clerk/react` supply-chain / typosquat concern (real package is `@clerk/clerk-react`) is the excluded finding.
- The removed `@convex-dev/auth` and `@auth/core` are still imported by `convex/auth.ts`, `src/main.tsx`, and `src/App.tsx`. This breaks the build (TypeScript/Vite/Convex will hard-fail on missing modules) — a broken build, not a fail-open auth bypass, since the app cannot start with unresolvable imports.
- The new `@clerk/react` package isn't imported anywhere in the code, so it introduces no runtime sinks in this diff.
- Version-pin loosening (exact `0.41.1` → caret `^6.12.5`) is subsumed by the excluded supply-chain finding.

No additional distinct vulnerabilities beyond the excluded typosquat.
